name: Barbell Close-Grip Curl
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a barbell in front of your thighs using an underhand grip narrower than shoulder width.
Tuck your elbows snugly against your sides and brace your core.
Curl the bar smoothly upward toward your chest without letting your elbows drift forward.
Lower the bar slowly back to near full arm extension under full control.
tips: Keep your shoulders still and avoid leaning back as the bar rises.
Keep your wrists straight rather than letting them bend backward under load.
